paper.title_en: Ostrowski-type inequalities for Riemann-Liouville fractional Lupaş-Kantorovich operators
paper.abstract_en: In this study, we derive Ostrowski-type inequalities associated with the Riemann-Liouville type fractional Lupaş-Kantorovich operators (for short RLFLK operators), created by merging the Lupaş-Kantorovich operator with the Riemann-Liouville fractional integral operator. The main tools of our approach are the notions of convexity and boundedness. Based on this framework, we establish several integral inequalities linked to the Ostrowski-type results for RLFLK operators. Moreover, we provide a key integral identity involving RLFLK operators on differentiable functions, which forms the basis of our method. We also support our theoretical findings with numerical examples and graphical illustrations. To the best of our knowledge, these results represent the first systematic investigation of integral inequalities in the framework of RLFLK operators.
